items.title: 14.9 Hawa ke mayar aur insani sehat ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.9 heading, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Hawa ke mayar aur insani sehat ka taalluq achhi tarah darj aur aham hai: kharab hawa ke fauri aur lambi muddat ke sehat par asrat hote hain. Bare pollutants aur un ke asrat 14.9.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Hawa ki aaloodgi ke sehat par asrat fauri aur lambi muddat dono kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada aaloodgi ka ek din foran aankhein aur saans ki naliyan jala aur asthma ke daure la sakta hai, jabke saalon aaloodi hawa mein saans lena aahista purani bronchitis, dil ki bimari aur cancer karta hai; dono qism ka nuqsan hospital mein dakhle aur maut ki sharh mein napa jata hai.

items: Kharab hawa ke fauri aur lambi muddat ke sehat par asrat hain.
